strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 8

Price Range: 1 point

Overview: Exeggutor's biggest shortcomings include its poor Speed, four-moveslot syndrome, poor coverage options, and a multitude of weaknesses, including to common moves such as Knock Off and U-turn. All of this causes it to be outclassed by comparable Grass-type Pokemon that are either stronger or bulkier. However, Exeggutor also has some pretty serviceable traits going for it, including a great Special Attack that can turn it into a solid wallbreaker, good utility options, and decent bulk paired with some neat resistances. Furthermore, it can use Harvest to check certain Pokemon with repeated Sitrus or Custap Berries.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Slow Wallbreaker Exeggutor can use its great Special Attack stat to be a slow-but-powerful wallbreaker. It can set up with Calm Mind to strengthen its offensive profile and Swords Dance to surprise opponents not expecting a physical moveset. Furthermore, it can use Trick Room in order to flip the matchups against faster foes and wallbreak with greater efficiency. Finally, despite being outclassed by many faster alternatives, Exeggutor can use Chlorophyll to contribute to a sun-based draft in games where it would be an effective option for speed control.

Tank: Exeggutor can use Harvest to make itself very hard to KO by pairing Sitrus Berries with utility moves such as Protect, Substitute, and Leech Seed in order to wear down an opponent's team. It can also use repeated Custap Berries to go first multiple times and deny a faster foe from eliminating it.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Energy Ball, Future Sight, Leaf Storm, Giga Drain, Grass Knot, Psychic, Psychic Noise, Psyshock, Seed Bomb, Solar Beam, Stored Power, Wood Hammer, Zen Headbutt

Setup Moves: Calm Mind, Swords Dance

Utility Moves: Leech Seed, Light Screen, Moonlight, Protect, Reflect, Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, Substitute, Synthesis, Trick, Trick Room

Coverage: Ancient Power, Earthquake, Low Kick, Stomping Tantrum, Sludge Bomb, Tera Blast

Niche Moves

Endure: Exeggutor can use Endure + Custap Berry better than most Pokemon, since it can potentially use it multiple times. This can allow it to use Sleep Powder to incapacitate an opponent or fire off strong attacks.

Growth: On Chlorophyll sets, Exeggutor can set up with Growth to become a mixed attacker that can potentially sweep or punch major holes for its teammates.

Common Items

Damage-boosting Items Exeggutor can utilize Life Orb, Miracle Seed, or Twisted Spoon to increase the power of its moves on more offensive sets.

Custap Berry: Exeggutor can pair Custap Berry with Harvest and fire off repeated attacks as long as it doesn't risk losing its item prematurely or in the face of opposing priority attacks.

Sitrus Berry: Exeggutor can use Sitrus Berry on Harvest sets to constantly heal, commonly pairing it with some combination of Protect, Leech Seed, and Substitute to stay healthy throughout a match.

Niche Items

Leftovers: Exeggutor can heal naturally with either Synthesis or Moonlight and can use Leftovers for increased passive recovery. This can also be useful on offensive sets that appreciate the added longevity.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries—most commonly, Tanga, Occa, and Yache berry—can allow Exeggutor to survive super effective hits. It can also use Colbur Berry on Harvest sets to have a consistent way to deal with Knock Off, a move that would otherwise greatly annoy it.

Heavy-Duty Boots: Exeggutor can use Heavy-Duty Boots to bypass the entry hazards that might cut into its bulk whenever it hits the field.

Tera

Exeggutor is not a very good choice for a Tera Captain, since it is outclassed by better defensive and offensive Pokemon. If it is made a Captain, Exeggutor can benefit from Tera Steel, Fairy, and Grass to boost its defensive profile and remove many of its weaknesses. Offensively, Tera Fire gives Exeggutor coverage to fry Steel-types that otherwise annoy it, and it can be very potent on sun teams.

Draft Strategy

Exeggutor is not going to be brought to most games and shouldn't be a major centerpiece, since it is flawed both offensively and defensively. That said, it's still serviceable and appreciates partners that can help deal with its common checks. This includes answers to U-turn and Knock Off as well as strong Fighting- and Fire-types to muscle past the Pokemon it struggles with.

Checks and Counters

Bug-type Moves: U-turn and other Bug-type moves prey upon Exeggutor's nasty 4x weakness to Bug. Bug Buzz from Pokemon such as Volcarona and Yanmega is bad news, since it bypasses Substitute. Many Pokemon that Exeggutor would like to check can also bring coverage to deny it from being useful.

Knock Off: Knock Off from strong Pokemon such as Kingambit, Mamoswine, and Metagross cripples Harvest sets and impedes Exeggutor's defensive profile even more.

Bulky Steel-types: Without Terastallization, various Steel-type Pokemon are able to blank Exeggutor offensively, including Corviknight, Bronzong, and Scizor.

Disruption: Exeggutor's low Speed can cause it to be easily disrupted by a wide range of Pokemon with Taunt and Encore, preventing it from making progress.
